definitions.gloss: immigration control; the immigration agency or its offices
definitions.explanation: Short for {出入国管理|しゅつにゅうこくかんり}, immigration control, and for the government body that handles it, today the {出入国在留管理庁|しゅつにゅうこくざいりゅうかんりちょう} (Immigration Services Agency).

examples.japanese: {入管|にゅうかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went through the procedures at the immigration office.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入管|にゅうかん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the immigration office to renew my visa.

examples.japanese: {入管|にゅうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{混|こ}んでいて→混む：02574_komu⟧、⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The immigration counters are always crowded, and you sometimes wait half a day.

notes:
The everyday and news abbreviation. Foreign residents use it for the regional immigration bureau where visas and residence cards are handled; in the news it also stands for immigration policy and detention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入管|にゅうかん}{法|ほう}: the Immigration Control Act
- {入管|にゅうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: the immigration counter
- {入管|にゅうかん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧: an immigration detention facility
- ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{入管|にゅうかん}: the Tokyo regional immigration bureau

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}{審査|しんさ}→入国審査：19565_nyuukokushinsa⟧: immigration inspection at the airport
- ⟦{入館|にゅうかん}→入館：31956_nyuukan⟧: entering a building (same reading)
